test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

The coach’s instructions were __concise__, providing clear guidance to the team.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2) i.e. "Brief".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Concise: (संक्षिप्त)** - Expressing much in a few words. 

 
 
• **Example**: Her explanation was concise and to the point.
 
 
 
• **Brief: (संक्षिप्त) **- Short in duration; not lasting for long. 
 
 
• **Example: **The meeting was very brief.
 
 
 
• Concise and brief both imply conveying information in a compressed, to-the-point manner, making "brief" contextually fitting here. 

**Therefore, the correct answer is *"Brief"***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Verbose**: (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण) - Using or expressed in more words than needed. 

 
 
• **Example**: His verbose explanation confused the audience more than it clarified.
 
 
 
• **Many**: (बहुत से) - A large number of. 
 
 
• **Example**: She bought many books from the sale.
 
 
 
• **Lengthy**: (लंबा) - Of considerable or unusual length, especially in time. 
 
 
• **Example**: It was a lengthy process to complete the documentation.
